description: Forward-looking financial intelligence: liquid savings signal (can we splurge?), named planning goals (Alex's Pacific Rim trip, medical budget), and college tuition horizon tracking for Jordan (2028) and Casey (2030). The 'looking ahead' complement to the budget's 'looking at now.'

timing.gatingCondition: Features 4 + 7 complete — budget snapshots provide baseline data, Magic Actions provide forecasting capability.

principles: Savings signal must be immediately scannable — emoji status at a glance
Goals are motivating, not stressful — progress bars, not countdown timers
529 tracking is contribution-only — no investment performance (out of scope)
Thresholds are configurable — Eric's comfort level is subjective

techStack.testing: Jest for signal computation and goal projection logic

userStories.title: Liquid savings signal
acceptanceCriteria: Compute: total across all savings accounts + checking buffer (checking balance minus rolling monthly spend)
Signal status: Tight (< 2x monthly expenses), Comfortable (2-4x), Ready to Splurge (> 4x)
Thresholds configurable via admin settings
Signal displayed prominently on dashboard (emoji + label + dollar amount)
Savings snapshot stored in savings_signals table with timestamp
Recomputed daily after sync
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests for signal computation at each threshold boundary. Configuration change test. Snapshot persistence test.

userStories.title: Named planning goals (R&R / Travel)
acceptanceCriteria: CRUD for planning goals: name, target amount, current amount, deadline (optional), linked account (optional)
First goal: 'Alex\'s Pacific Rim Trip' with configurable target
Progress bar: current / target with percentage
If linked to savings account, current amount auto-updates from account balance
If manual, current amount editable via admin
Projected achievement date: based on average monthly savings rate
Planning section on dashboard shows all active goals
userStories.testStrategy: CRUD API tests. Progress calculation test. Projection date calculation test with known savings rate. Auto-update from linked account test.

userStories.title: Medical expense planning
acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated 'Medical' budget category with annual target (in addition to monthly budget)
Quarterly tracking: Q1-Q4 medical spend vs. annual pace
Rolling 3-year average for medical spend (from imported + synced data)
Alert when YTD medical spend approaches annual average (configurable threshold, default 80%)
Medical planning card on dashboard: YTD spend, annual target, 3-year average, pace indicator
userStories.testStrategy: Annual pace calculation test. Rolling 3-year average with partial year data. Alert threshold test.

userStories.title: College tuition horizon
acceptanceCriteria: Two tuition milestones: Jordan (September 2028), Casey (September 2030)
Planning view: months remaining countdown for each
529 contribution tracking: detect transactions categorized as 529_contribution transfer type
Monthly and YTD 529 contribution totals displayed per child
No investment performance tracking — contribution detection only
Visual: timeline or progress indicator showing preparation status
userStories.testStrategy: Countdown calculation test (handles edge cases: past dates, exact month). 529 contribution detection test from categorized transactions.

high: Savings signal false confidence — 'Splurge Ready' status must account for known upcoming large expenses (medical, tuition)
medium: Projected achievement dates are linear extrapolations — savings rates fluctuate, projections could mislead
Medical 3-year average requires 3 years of data — may need to seed from Monarch import or show 'insufficient data' gracefully
low: 529 contribution patterns may vary by institution — pattern matching needs to cover common 529 providers
